name: depth_product
reviewed: wave-1 adversarial review (deepseek-v4-flash); findings manually verified before adoption (PRIMARY_RULE lines confirmed; 7047/4735/2312 split arithmetic reconciled from roads.json)
path: runs/<run_id>/products/segment_status.csv (+ .json twin for API) consumed read-only by dashboard + routing API
producer: src/jaladhar/validation/segment_status.py (WF-3, GREENFIELD - does not exist yet) calling realized evaluate_segments_from_mask machinery PLUS mandatory synthesis of no_data rows

schema_fields.run_id: string - runs/<run_id>/ directory name that produced this row; dashboard displays it, never parses from path
schema_fields.segment_id: int32 dense key 1..176171 stable-sorted by OSM way id (roads.py:88-102 assign_segment_ids), CRS EPSG:32643; lookup data/interim/terrain/roads_segment_lookup.csv (176171 rows)
schema_fields.band_low_cm band_high_cm: MIN and MAX depth over the segment's canonical-raster cells, integer cm FLOOR-ROUNDED from float m. PINNED: min/max, NOT percentiles (percentile upgrade would be a NEW versioned field, never a redefinition)
schema_fields.confidence: enum[modeled_direct, modeled_interpolated, no_data]; modeled_direct = >=1 canonical cell with directly-modeled depth; modeled_interpolated = RESERVED, never produced in v1.0.0 (matrix row is forward-design, not live); no_data = ZERO canonical cells
schema_fields.flood_status: enum[flooded, not_flooded, unknown] reusing PRIMARY_RULE D=0.15 m F=20% N=3-contiguous-cells semantics from segment_validation.evaluate_segments_from_mask (:52-54, :80-90) - ONE rule everywhere; computed from float-m cell mask (depth>=0.15 m per :762), NEVER inferred from the integer-cm band (14.9 cm floors to 14 AND is not flooded; multi-cell segment can have band_low>=15 yet fail F/N rule - consumers read flood_status, never derive it)
schema_fields.valid_time_utc: SIMULATION VALID TIME the depth state represents; ISO8601 aware UTC mandated
schema_fields.issue_time_utc: ISSUE WALL TIME when row was written; aware UTC; routing lead derived by API as issue_time_utc - now; assertion: issue_time_utc >= valid_time_utc ONLY for forecast_lead_minutes==0 (nowcast rows); forecast rows (lead>0) carry a FUTURE valid time and must satisfy issue_time_utc <= valid_time_utc
schema_fields.forecast_lead_minutes: FORECAST lead of the driving rainfall: 0 = nowcast analysis moment (water on ground, near-certain); >0 = forecast rain, CONDITIONAL. NEVER conflated with routing lead (CLAUDE.md reporting rules)
schema_fields.source_manifest_path: relative path from repo root of producing run manifest; must exist

band_rules.not_flooded_all_cells_dry: also [0,0] - indistinguishable from unknown by band alone; flood_status disambiguates
band_rules.flooded_implies: band_high_cm >= 15 ALWAYS (at least one cell >= 0.15 m); band [0,0]+flooded is a SCHEMA VIOLATION

no_data_segments_measured_split.derivation: 176171 lookup ids - 169124 canonical unique = 7047; 176171 - 173859 buffered unique = 2312; 173859-169124 = 4735 (roads.json measured)
no_data_segments_measured_split.producer_obligation: ALL 7047 appear as confidence=no_data flood_status=unknown band=[0,0] - realized scorer returns only raster-present segments so synthesis is MANDATORY not optional

manifest_guarantees_producer_writes: source_manifest_path per file (single manifest covers CSV; each row repeats it)

depth_convention 'PRIMARY_RULE D0.15 F0.20 N3' + grid identity EPSG:32643 3421x3515 10m matching road_segment_id.tif + input depth tif sha256 + coupling state declaration (depth field is POST-couple_step h_new when coupling_enabled=true in source run manifest)
n_segments_expected 176171 (consumer asserts len(product)==manifest.n_segments_expected==len(lookup ids) - never hardcoded consumer-side)
surcharge_events.csv present in source run dir IFF source manifest coupling_enabled=true (cross-product consistency)
consumer_assertions_at_load: both timestamps parse aware-UTC (naive reject); lead==0 rows: issue_time_utc >= valid_time_utc; lead>0 rows: issue_time_utc <= valid_time_utc
full 3x3 confidence x flood_status matrix enforced (4 ILLEGAL combos refuse: modeled_direct+unknown, modeled_interpolated+unknown [forward-design cell], no_data+flooded, no_data+not_flooded)
source_manifest_path exists; run_id matches path; surcharge_events.csv presence matches coupling flag
rationale: Segment scheme quoted from realized code and uniqueness verified; lattice shared so joins are direct indexing; measured 7047 gap turned into explicit schema states with corrected 4735/2312 provenance split (draft's original claim that all 7047 were buffered-margin was wrong for 2312); G1 scores the same flood_status the dashboard renders - UI can never show a number the gate did not produce (rules 2/3); timestamp split kills sim-vs-issue ambiguity; forecast-vs-routing lead separation is CLAUDE.md-mandated.
open_questions: Dashboard poll cadence vs product write cadence under G4 budget - recommended producer-stamps/API-serves-immutable, owner sign-off pending
Routing API scope: segments ONLY recommended (per-square-metre depth is a metric claim we cannot support at 10 m)
Gate verdict fields (G1 pass/fail, hit rate, lift, null CI) deliberately NOT in this product - separate gate_verdict artefact if dashboard must render gate status
